title: The Road to Damascus
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever discovered that the thing you were most certain about was the thing you most needed to let go?
reflectionText: He was absolutely certain he was right. He had the credentials, the authority, the conviction. And he was completely wrong. The light on the road did not give him new information. It gave him a new identity. What is it to discover that the thing you were most sure of was the thing you most needed to lay down?
